terms.comment: Our description, a bicycle without pedals. Bicycle parts remain in the travel section.

phrases.latin: Theodōrus birotam suam, parvam, sine pedālibus, quam pedibus pellit
phrases.english: Theo’s little balance bike, with no pedals, which he pushes along with his feet

sources: Descriptions and prompts labelled as ours are composed for family conversation. Recorded vocabulary does not imply universal technical standardization.
